digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI (+ Mgombato for chende, mnyau)

teaser.en: 'The cat's testicles': a frank Digo name for a shrub whose paired, rounded fruits leave little to the imagination.
teaser.sw: 'Mapumbu ya paka': jina la Kidigo lisilo na kificho kwa kichaka ambacho matunda yake ya mviringo yaliyo kwa jozi hayaachi mengi ya kukisia.

summary.en: Machende ga mnyau is a shrub or small tree with wavy-edged leaves and small, rounded capsules. The name compares the fruits to a cat's testicles.
summary.sw: Machende ga mnyau ni kichaka au mti mdogo wenye majani ya kingo za mawimbi na vibuyu vidogo vya mviringo. Jina linalinganisha matunda yake na korodani ya paka.

about.en: Machende ga mnyau is a spineless shrub or small tree. Its leaves are elliptic with finely toothed edges that are often wavy (*undata* means 'wavy'), and they are paler underneath. Small greenish-yellow flowers grow in clusters in the leaf axils. They are followed by small, rounded capsules, yellowish to reddish, that split to show seeds partly covered by a fleshy coat. It is now often placed in the genus *Gymnosporia*.
about.sw: Machende ga mnyau ni kichaka au mti mdogo usio na miiba. Majani yake ni ya umbo la duaradufu, yenye meno madogo kingoni ambayo mara nyingi ni ya mawimbi (*undata* maana yake 'ya mawimbi'), na yana rangi hafifu zaidi upande wa chini. Maua madogo ya kijani-manjano huota kwa vishada kwenye makwapa ya majani. Hufuatwa na vibuyu vidogo vya mviringo, vya manjano hadi mekundu, vinavyopasuka kuonyesha mbegu zilizofunikwa kwa sehemu na ganda lenye nyama. Siku hizi mara nyingi huwekwa katika jenasi *Gymnosporia*.

where.en: It grows in forest margins, thicket and rocky bushland.
where.sw: Hukua pembezoni mwa misitu, vichakani na katika vichaka vya miamba.

culture.en: Many Digo plant names describe a part of the plant by comparison with an animal. Pakia explains this one as 'testis of cat'. The fruits are thought to resemble the testicles (*machende*) of a cat (*mnyau*).
culture.sw: Majina mengi ya mimea ya Kidigo yanaeleza sehemu ya mmea kwa kuilinganisha na mnyama. Pakia analieleza hili kama 'korodani la paka'. Matunda yanadhaniwa kufanana na korodani (*machende*) ya paka (*mnyau*).

names.en: Digo: *machende ga mnyau*, 'testis of cat'. In Mgombato, *chende* (plural *machende*) is scrotum or testicle (Swahili *kende*), and *mnyau* is cat. Pakia records it only for Digo. In southern Africa it is known as the koko tree. Its relative *Maytenus heterophylla* is *mtsokola ng'ongo*.
names.sw: Kidigo: *machende ga mnyau*, 'korodani la paka'. Katika Mgombato, *chende* (wingi *machende*) ni korodani au korodani (Kiswahili *kende*), na *mnyau* ni paka. Pakia anaurekodi kwa Kidigo tu. Kusini mwa Afrika unajulikana kama *koko tree*. Ndugu yake *Maytenus heterophylla* ni *mtsokola ng'ongo*.

reason.en: Salacia, another member of the same family
reason.sw: Salacia, mmea mwingine wa familia ileile

reason.en: Another frank Digo name taken from an animal's body
reason.sw: Jina jingine la Kidigo lisilo na kificho linalotokana na mwili wa mnyama

mgombato: chende (vy) scrotum, testicle; kende, pumbu, korodani. (See: ngoko)
